dataList.content:
The child roared with vivacious yet sanguinary laughter.
孩子的笑声十分欢快，但又充斥着一种令人毛骨悚然的感觉。

Next! Keep on blasting!
下一个家伙！继续射击！
dataList.title:

dataList.content:
His gun relentlessly belched flame.
孩子的枪口连续不断地喷射出火焰。

The child wore a wide grin on his face, letting spatters of blood splash onto his cheeks and clothes as if letting go of the trigger was never an option.
仿佛根本没有将手指移开扳机这一选项一般，孩子咧嘴大笑着，任由敌人的血滴飞溅到他的脸颊和衣服上。

Ammo’s spent!
子弹怎么打完了！
dataList.title:

dataList.content:
Just as those furious flashes finally seemed to settle down, the child flung the spent gun at his foe.
原以为那疯狂的火光终于平息，没想到那孩子马上把用尽弹药的枪支扔向了敌人。

The red-hot block of metal struck the target directly, rapidly igniting their clothes.
灼热的枪支直接命中了敌人的身体，并迅速点燃了目标的衣物。

If I can’t use my paws to plow through the grass, I’ll just bare my teeth!
如果没有可以刨开鲜草的前脚，那就用牙齿来撕咬！

dataList.content:
The child unsheathes his knife and lunges forward. Binkying toward them like a rabbit, he tears his foes to tatters.
孩子拔出他的刀向前冲去。就像是一只兔子一样向前跳跃，将敌人杀的片甲不留。

This suit… Damn, I’m loving this thing! I feel stronger with each scrag!
这件衣服……妈的，我都要爱上它了！真是感觉越杀越强！

dataList.content:
His gleaming eyes seemed to suggest some kind of intoxication…
孩子闪闪发光的眼睛仿佛陶醉于某物一般……

But, it looks like he’s having the time of his life. Nothing to worry about, right?
不过，看起来他乐于此道，倒也不必过于担心。对吧？
